verdict.rationale: Klaviyo can be driven headlessly through its REST API. Non-interactive private API keys with scopes authenticate every /api endpoint, and maintained server-side SDKs (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) cover scripted use. Endpoints exist for creating campaigns and events, rate-limit headers support programmatic backoff, and separate test accounts let integrations run without touching production. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/CD or headless-automation guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted pipeline use.
